portal.title: Patient portal
portal.tagline: Book with the professional you need, at a time that is genuinely free.
portal.valueLine: Every slot you see has already been checked against the professional's calendar, the room, and your own appointments.
portal.signInNote: We use your Google account so you do not need another password.

profile.title: Profile and consents
profile.description: The data we hold about you, and what you have agreed to. We keep the minimum we need to schedule your appointments.
profile.contactEmailNote: Comes from your Google account and cannot be changed here.
profile.contactPhoneNote: Only used if reception needs to reach you about an appointment.
profile.revokeConfirm: Withdrawing this consent may stop us from managing your appointments.

staff.title: Staff console
staff.signInInternalNote: Use the email and password your administrator gave you.
staff.signInProfessionalNote: Sign in with the Google account your clinic registered for you.
staff.changePasswordNote: This account is still using the password it was created with. Choose your own before continuing.
staff.newPasswordHint: At least {{count}} characters. Length matters more than symbols.

users.title: Users
users.description: Staff accounts and professional invitations. Patients appear when they first sign in.
users.addNote: A professional is registered by the email address they will sign in with — their first Google sign-in claims the account.
users.disabled: Account disabled and its sessions ended.
users.professionalPasswordNote: Professionals do not get a password.
users.takenTitle: That address already belongs to an account
users.takenNote: A role never changes here, so the account holding the address has to be retired before the address can be registered again. Find out which account uses it, then decide.
users.holderNone: No active account uses that address now. Register it again above.
users.retire: Retire this account and free the address
users.retireNote: Access ends immediately and the address becomes available again. The account and its history are kept, and no role is changed — you register the address afresh as a new account.
users.retired: Account retired. The address is free — register it again above.

errors.auth_session_expired: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
errors.auth_forbidden: You do not have permission to do that.
errors.auth_ownership_denied: You can only view your own data.
errors.auth_invalid_credentials: That email and password do not match.
errors.auth_current_password_invalid: That current password is not correct.
errors.auth_account_disabled: This account has been disabled. Please contact your administrator.
errors.auth_password_change_required: Choose a new password before continuing.
errors.auth_rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please try again in a moment.
errors.auth_google_failed: Google sign-in did not complete. Please try again — and if you use an email and password for this clinic, sign in with those instead.
errors.auth_google_unavailable: Google sign-in is not available on this installation.
errors.auth_not_provisioned: This clinic has not registered an account for that Google address. Ask administration to register your access, then sign in again.
errors.auth_use_patient_sign_in: This is a patient account. Sign in on the patient portal instead — the staff console is only for accounts the clinic registers for its team.
errors.auth_use_staff_sign_in: This account is registered as a clinic professional. Sign in through the staff console instead.
errors.auth_consent_required: That requires a consent you have not granted.
errors.auth_email_already_in_use: Another account already uses that email.
errors.validation_invalid_format: That value is not in the expected format.
errors.server_unexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.config_in_use: Still used by {{records}} active record(s). Deactivate those first.
errors.config_duplicate_name: An active item already has that name.
errors.config_not_found: That item does not exist, or is not active.
errors.config_specialty_not_held: This professional does not hold the specialty this kind of visit belongs to. Assign the specialty first.
errors.config_working_hours_overlap: These hours overlap hours already set for that day.
errors.config_working_hours_invalid: Hours must end after they start, on the same day.
errors.block_invalid_range: The end must come after the start.
errors.availability_window_invalid: That date range cannot be searched. Please choose a shorter one.
errors.booking_slot_taken: Someone booked that time just before you. Please choose another.
errors.booking_slot_blocked: The professional is not available at that time. Please choose another.
errors.booking_patient_busy: You already have an appointment at that time.
errors.booking_resource_unavailable: No room of the kind this visit needs is free at that time.
errors.booking_outside_working_hours: That time is outside the professional's working hours.
errors.booking_lead_time_violation: That time is too soon. Please choose a later one.
errors.booking_horizon_exceeded: That date is further ahead than the clinic takes bookings.
errors.booking_specialty_mismatch: That professional no longer offers this kind of visit.
errors.booking_block_overlaps_appointment: You have an appointment in that period. Cancel it first, or block a different time.
errors.availability_unavailable: Free times cannot be worked out right now. Please try again shortly.
errors.booking_cutoff_passed: This appointment is too close to change online. Please call reception.
errors.booking_appointment_not_changeable: This appointment has already been cancelled or moved.
errors.calendar_not_connected: There is no connected calendar to act on.
errors.calendar_consent_revoked: Your calendar permission was withdrawn at Google. Reconnect to restore it.
errors.calendar_sync_failed: We could not reach Google just now. Your connection has not been changed — try again in a moment.
errors.calendar_scope_declined: Calendar permission was not granted. Connect again and allow calendar access.
errors.calendar_connect_failed: Google did not return the permission we need. Connect again and allow calendar access.

catalog.specialtiesDescription: The disciplines this clinic practises. Every kind of visit belongs to one.
catalog.resourcesDescription: The rooms and equipment this clinic has, and what kind each one is.
catalog.appointmentTypesDescription: The kinds of visit offered. Each belongs to a specialty and needs one kind of room or equipment.
catalog.resourceTypesNote: A kind of room or equipment, with the turnaround time needed after each appointment.
catalog.resourcesNote: The individual rooms and machines. Each one is of a resource type.
catalog.name: Name
catalog.turnaroundHint: Time kept free after each appointment for cleaning or preparation.
catalog.needsActiveResourceType: Add an active resource type first.

professionals.title: Professionals
professionals.description: What each professional is qualified for, how long they take, and when they work.
professionals.listEmpty: No professionals have been invited yet. Invite one on the Users screen first.
professionals.specialtiesNote: What this professional is qualified for. This is what makes a kind of visit assignable below.
professionals.noSpecialtiesLeft: Every active specialty is already assigned.
professionals.durationsNote: How long this professional takes for each kind of visit. Durations vary by professional, which is why they are set here rather than on the visit type.
professionals.durationsGateEmpty: Assign a specialty above first — the kinds of visit offered here are the ones its specialties allow.
professionals.hoursNote: The recurring week. Times are the clinic's local times; a split day is two blocks.
professionals.exceptionsNote: One-off changes for this professional on a single date. A clinic-wide closure is entered once per professional.
professionals.fullNameHint: How this professional is shown to patients and to reception.

blocks.title: Blocked time
blocks.description: Periods you are unavailable. These are removed from the times patients can book with you.
blocks.timezoneNote: Times are the clinic's local time ({{timezone}}).

booking.title: Book an appointment
booking.description: Every time below is genuinely free: the professional is working and not booked, and a room of the right kind is available.
booking.professionalHint: Leave as any professional to see everyone qualified.
booking.resultSummary_one: {{count}} time available, shown in the clinic's timezone ({{timezone}}).
booking.resultSummary_other: {{count}} times available, shown in the clinic's timezone ({{timezone}}).
booking.emptyHint: Try a later window, another kind of visit, or any professional.
booking.noServices: This clinic has not published anything bookable yet.
booking.confirmDescription: Nothing is booked until you confirm.
booking.confirmMissing: There is no appointment to confirm. Please choose a time again.
booking.detailsHint: We ask for a phone number so the clinic can reach you about this appointment. Nothing else is needed.
booking.consentActive: Your data-processing consent is in place (version {{version}}).
booking.consentRequired: Booking needs your consent to process your personal data. You can grant it here and carry on.
booking.successMissing: There is nothing to show here. Your appointments live on your profile.
booking.timezoneNote: Times are the clinic's local time ({{timezone}}).
booking.whatNextBody: Please arrive a few minutes early. If you need to change or cancel, contact reception.
booking.checkedRoom: A free room of the required type

appointments.title: My appointments
appointments.subtitle: Everything you have booked, and everything you have had.
appointments.locked: This appointment is too close to change online. Please call reception.
appointments.notFound: That appointment is not on your list.
appointments.rescheduleSubtitle: Pick any free time below. Nothing changes until you choose one.
appointments.movingTo: New times available, shown in the clinic's timezone ({{timezone}}).
appointments.sameProfessionalNote: The professional and the kind of visit stay the same. To see someone else, cancel this appointment and book a new one.

schedule.myDescription: Your appointments and blocked time for the day.
schedule.dayDescription: Everything booked across the clinic for the day.
schedule.blocksEmpty: No blocked time for this day.
schedule.timezoneNote: Times are the clinic's local time ({{timezone}}).
schedule.patientLocked: The patient can no longer change this
schedule.patientLockedNote: Inside the cancellation cutoff. Reception can still act.
schedule.cancelBody: The time will be free again for {{patient}} at {{time}}. This cannot be undone.
schedule.accessNote: Patient names on this screen are personal data. Opening it is recorded against your account.

deskBooking.title: Book for a patient
deskBooking.description: Find a patient, then a time. The appointment is recorded as booked by reception.
deskBooking.emailHint: The exact address on their record.
deskBooking.consentMissing: This patient has not granted data-processing consent, so a booking will be refused. They can grant it in the patient portal.
deskBooking.noSlots: Nothing free on this day. Try another date.
deskBooking.roomNote: The room a time would use. The assigned one is confirmed after booking.
deskBooking.moveDescription: Choosing a time moves this appointment. The professional and kind of visit stay the same.
deskBooking.moveNotFound: This appointment is not on the day that was opened. Go back to the day view and choose Move again.

calendar.title: Google Calendar
calendar.description: Connect your Google Calendar so your appointments here can appear in it. This is separate from signing in, and you can withdraw it at any time.
calendar.nothingSyncsYet: Connecting does not move anything yet — appointments start appearing in your calendar in the next increment. Connecting now means nothing has to be set up later.
calendar.revokedExplanation: This clinic no longer has permission to your calendar. Reconnect to restore it.
calendar.disconnectedExplanation: You withdrew this clinic's access to your calendar.
calendar.notConnectedExplanation: You have not connected a calendar. Nothing is required of you — connect when you want to.
calendar.staleNote: This is what we saw when we last checked. Use “Check connection” to ask Google again.
calendar.checkedOk: Google confirms the connection is working.
calendar.disconnectExplanation: This withdraws your calendar permission and deletes the credential stored here. We also ask Google to remove this clinic's access.
calendar.disconnectedNotAtProvider: Your calendar has been disconnected here, but we could not confirm it with Google. Remove “Consult Rio” from your Google account permissions to finish: myaccount.google.com/permissions
calendar.unavailable: Calendar connection is not configured for this deployment.
